en: A colorized view over a river bordered by lush trees toward a hillside spa town. Elegant villas and townhouses line the slope, and a tall church with a pointed spire dominates the skyline. At the riverbank there is a wooden boathouse or pavilion with several small boats moored nearby. The sky shows a soft gradient from pink to blue. In the upper left corner, the caption "Bad Elster" is printed.
